result:
Round 134 (VISUAL-A V-0.3a, grid and Snap texts in English) **passes**, with no new bugs. I ran every browser row in real Chromium at both 1440×900 and 1280×720, so `browserVerified` and `realVerified` are true. One check is blocked: the fake-Bearer 403 test needs the backend, which isn't available in the cloud.

**Offline checks**
- **Targeted tests:** I re-ran A's 23-file list and all 409 tests are green. The counts match A's.
- **Source scope:** the tree is exactly 16 modified files plus the new doc 110. The frozen list and A's 17 end hashes check out, and the protected auth/route files are unchanged. No source changed while I worked.
- **Code review:**
  - The source changes are text only.
  - I re-extracted the 33 Georgian lines that stay in `StudioWorkspace.tsx` myself; they are byte-identical to the baseline.
  - Test matcher counts are the same before and after, with no added skip/only/todo.
  - No fact was lost in any of the 20 translations.
  - A's one declared deviation (Biome put the Snap title ternary on one line) keeps the same condition and order, so I accepted it.
  - I reviewed A's mutation logs but did not re-run them, because I make no writes in `store/`.

**Browser rows**
- **Grid in seconds:** the option labels, aria-label, title, every 1/2 step status and both end messages are exact. The grid step and line spacing match each division.
- **Grid with a BPM:** the statuses are exact, and the "Tempo cleared" message is now fully English (this closes GATE132-TEMPO-CLEARED-MIXED). A clip kept its start and length through all 14 steps.
- **Triplets:** all three refusal messages are exact and leave the division unchanged. 1/4T gives the expected 0.444 s step, and the menu item "Triplets (3)" is checked.
- **Hidden grid lines:** the title switches exactly when the lines appear or disappear.
- **Snap:** pressing G gives the right status and button title each way. With Snap on, a drag of +0.4 s snaps back to 2 s and +0.7 s lands on 3 s; with Snap off, +0.4 s moves freely to 3.4 s.
- **Lane menu:** the label and items are in English, keyboard choice works, and the menu closes. The open/close code didn't change apart from its label line.
- **Georgian count:** 0 in the status line, grid select, menu and Snap title, over 95 steps.
- **Layout:** the grid select is 6 px narrower because its labels are shorter. The two controls to its right moved 6 px left and kept their size.
- **Earlier round and auth:** the round-133 Ctrl+G message is still correct. Without login, the demo page opens; the product page shows "Sign in required" and loads no audio; the token API returns 401.
- **Network:** no forbidden requests, no auth headers, no page or hydration errors.

**Runs I discarded**
- One first load crashed with the known dev-server first-load error; the retry was clean.
- Some early runs failed because of my harness, not the app. The task assumed Snap starts on, but it starts off, and the app always reported its real state correctly. At 1280 my first right-click hit a lane below the fold.

**Notes for B**
- Snap is off by default, so future rows should state the Snap state.
- The expected "Grid back to seconds: 0.5 s." only appears if 0.5 s was chosen before setting the BPM. I added that step, as the existing unit test does.
- The layout rule "every other box within 1 px" can't hold literally when the select narrows, because its neighbours shift with it. I treated that as part of the allowed text-width exception; B may want to say so explicitly for the next stages.
- The deferred grid-header overflow (C-R122-02) no longer reproduces, including at its own BPM 90 repro. B may close it at the polish pass.

I opened 14 of the screenshots. The rest are listed as not opened, and those rows rest on the DOM measurements.

Files are in `tmp/studio-real-loop/`:
- c-round-134.md
- c-round-134.json
- c-round-134/ (tools, out, shots)
